features.name: Grove Warden Magic
features.description:
Starting at 3rd level, you learn additional spells at certain ranger levels (don't count against spells known):

| Ranger Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 3rd | entangle |
| 5th | branding smite |
| 9th | speak with plants |
| 13th | hallucinatory terrain |
| 17th | animate objects |

features.name: Whispers of the Forest
features.description: At 3rd level, when you use Primeval Awareness while within a forest, you also sense humanoids. You know their general direction and whether they are solitary (1), a small group (2–5), or a pack (6+).

features.name: Forest's Will
features.description: At 3rd level, as a bonus action, choose a creature within 60 ft you can see. Your next weapon attack against it has advantage. On hit, its speed is reduced by 10 ft until the start of your next turn (halved at 11th level).

payload.name: Forest's Will
payload.description: Choose creature within 60 ft: advantage on next weapon attack. On hit: speed -10 ft until your next turn (halved at L11).

features.name: Intruder's Bane
features.description: At 7th level, as a bonus action, choose a point within 60 ft on the ground. The area within 15 ft undulates: each creature there makes a DEX save vs your spell save DC. Fail: pushed up to 15 ft in a direction of your choice and knocked prone. 1/short or long rest.

payload.name: Intruder's Bane
payload.description: Choose a point within 60 ft: 15-ft radius undulates. DEX save or pushed 15 ft and knocked prone.

features.name: Wrath of the Forest
features.description: At 11th level, when you take the Attack action, use a bonus action to make a natural object (rock, branch, root) attack a creature within 30 ft. You are proficient with the attack (magical), add DEX modifier to attack and damage rolls. Damage die is d8 (type appropriate to the object).

payload.name: Wrath of the Forest
payload.description: After Attack action: make a magical natural object attack vs a creature within 30 ft (proficient, DEX modifier, d8 damage).

features.name: Living Bulwark
features.description: Starting at 15th level, when a creature you can see targets you with an attack, you can use your reaction to roll a d8 and add it to your AC against that attack.

payload.name: Living Bulwark
payload.description: When targeted by an attack, roll 1d8 and add it to your AC against that attack.
